_comment: ComplianceRegistry is the live singleton (owner = deployerPublicKey / the backend platform key). ShareToken + Campaign are uploaded (WASM hashes); per-campaign instances are deployed from these hashes by the backend. USDC is a test SAC whose asset is issued by deployerPublicKey. campaignWasmHash was re-uploaded 2026-07-03 after the constructor gained milestone_amounts (Phase 7 milestones) plus the cancel/set_refund/refund_claim path (refund system) -- campaigns deployed from the previous hash (462eb8f0...) keep running under the old WASM; new deploys pick up this hash.
